name: SVR Poker Android

tablePolicy.humanRejoinBehavior: A deliberate leave clears the interrupted hand. JOIN TABLE starts a fresh six-player test table with 15,000 chips per seat.

androidExperience.audioMode: Web Audio synthesized poker effects with no missing-file dependency

avatarProfileProtection.note: The Phase 351 profile showroom and Phase 353 VR dressing room remain the avatar presentation authorities. Phase 365 does not duplicate them.

required: Table reference line is aligned to floor Y=0
MOVE and LOOK controls operate in lobby mode
Left input moves left and right input moves right
Exactly one MOVE and one LOOK control exist
JOIN TABLE hides MOVE, LOOK, LOBBY and CENTER controls
Gyroscope or touch drag looks around the seated table
Seated camera remains stable without bounce
Pot display is transparent, unframed and does not block avatars
Five opponent avatars align with canonical seats
Every opponent has a visible name and stack tag
SVR logo appears in the Android HUD
SVR brand appears on card backs
Tournament branding can be replaced through one runtime brand slot
Full hand still reaches settlement while conserving 90,000 chips
Profile 3D showroom and VR dressing room routes remain intact
No browser errors or failed asset requests

realDeviceValidation.target: Verify lobby sticks, JOIN hiding, phone gyro comfort, stable seated view, clean pot display, avatar/name visibility, table floor line and SVR branding on the owner Android device.

updateMessage: An optional SVR Poker Android update is available.
updateMenuPolicy: Hidden unless releaseReady is true, apkUrl is non-empty, and apkVersionCode is newer than the installed code.
